Lady Doak College vs The American College is a local Madurai choice between two well-known arts campuses. We have an MA year fee for Lady Doak, but no MA fee or recent placement row for The American College.

sections.heading: Lady Doak College vs The American College for MA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Lady Doak College if you want a women's college MA in English, Tamil, history or economics, with a recorded year total of ₹17,878, after you confirm the current official notice.

Choose The American College if you want an MA in English, Tamil or economics on a historic co-educational campus, and you are ready to get the fee directly from the college because our table has no MA fee row.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what is missing
paragraphs: For Lady Doak College we hold ₹17,878 as a Total Fees year figure for MA English, Tamil, history and economics. That is a year amount, not a confirmed two-year official total.
The American College has no MA fee row in our table. A blank cell is not a free degree. Use the official fee notice on americancollege.edu.in before you compare cost.
Both are private colleges in Madurai, so living costs may be similar. The missing American College fee is the main gap on this page.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We have no MA placement row for 2020 or later on either side, so this page cannot quote an average or highest package.
Many MA graduates in Madurai look at teaching, further research or local jobs. Ask both placement or alumni offices for recent examples rather than expecting a package table here.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official postgraduate admissions note for eligibility, dates and any department test or interview.
Subject lists overlap in English, Tamil and economics. Lady Doak also lists MA History. Confirm seats and shift details on the current prospectus.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, so a local student can visit them on the same day and compare libraries, departments and travel time.
Lady Doak College is a women's college. The American College is co-educational. That campus culture may matter as much as the fee line.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Lady Doak College if you want a women's campus and the recorded MA year total of ₹17,878 is clear enough, after you recheck the official notice.
Pick The American College if the department and co-educational campus fit you better, and you have the official MA fee in hand.
Because placements are missing, let subject, campus type and the official fee decide this, not an empty package cell.
